name: STIHL MS 462
blurb: 3/8″ .050″ chain: 91 drive links on 28″, 105 on 32″, 114 on 36″, per STIHL's 2025 chart. The 36″ loop is 33 RS, not 33 RS3.
intro: STIHL's 2025 chain chart lists the MS 462, MS 462 R, MS 462 C-M and MS 462 R C-M together. The .050″ rows that match their own marketing numbers are 33 RS3 91 on a 28″ bar, 33 RS3 105 on a 32″ bar, and 33 RS 114 on a 36″ bar. 33 RS is Rapid Super without the low-kickback “3”. All three bars are asterisk-marked (yellow-labeled).

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 91 with recommended bar 3003 000 8838. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5.2 mm (13/64″) file for 3/8″ chain. Oregon's 2020 filing chart gives 7/32″ for standard 3/8″ chain (types 72, 73, 75). The chart marks this bar with an asterisk: a reduced-kickback bar is not listed at this length.

STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 105 with recommended bar 3003 000 2246. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5.2 mm (13/64″) file for 3/8″ chain. Oregon's 2020 filing chart gives 7/32″ for standard 3/8″ chain (types 72, 73, 75). The chart marks this bar with an asterisk: a reduced-kickback bar is not listed at this length.

STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS 114 with recommended bar 3003 000 2253. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 5.2 mm (13/64″) file for 3/8″ chain. Oregon's 2020 filing chart gives 7/32″ for standard 3/8″ chain (types 72, 73, 75). The chart marks this bar with an asterisk: a reduced-kickback bar is not listed at this length.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pages 166–167), including the file table and the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel
Saw Chain Filing Angles / Grinding Angles chart (2020): 7/32″ round file for standard 3/8″ chain (types 72, 73, 75)

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog chain chart (catalog pp. 166–167), read 5 Nov 2026. File size: STIHL 2025 file table (13/64″ for 3/8″) and Oregon's 2020 filing chart (7/32″ for standard 3/8″ chain).
notice: STIHL's 2025 chart also prints a .063″ section in this model block. In that section the chain marketing numbers do not line up with the drive-link column (a count is printed next to a loop whose marketing number is a different count, or a .050″ loop is printed on a .063″ row). Those combinations are not listed. If your bar is stamped .063″, use the stamp.
